test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He was not able to answer as the question was __ambiguous__.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Clear. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"ambiguous"** means something that is open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning. (अस्पष्ट) • **Example: **The instructions she gave were so ambiguous that we didn't know what to do. • **"Clear" **refers to something that is easy to understand, free from ambiguity, and obvious. (स्पष्ट) • **Example: **The teacher's explanation was so clear that all the students understood the concept immediately. • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'ambiguous' **is **'clear'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Clear. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Deep **(गहरा): Extending far down from the top or surface. • **Example:** The ocean is incredibly deep at certain points. • **Superficial **(सतही): Existing or occurring at or on the surface. • **Example: **His understanding of the subject was quite superficial. • **Unsolvable** (असमाधेय): Impossible to solve or settle. • **Example:** The puzzle seemed unsolvable until we found the missing piece. 134:T442,
